'''Kavirayani Ramakrishna Prasad''' (born 7 January 1969) is an Indian [[chemist]]. He is working in synthesis in [[organic chemistry]]. He is working in [[Indian Institute of Science]]. He received [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology|Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar award]]s in 2014.<ref>{{cite web|title=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar awards for 10 scientists |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/states/shanti-swarup-bhatnagar-awards-for-10-scientists/article6450071.ece |publisher=BusinessLine |date=26 September 2014 |access-date=28 September 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Dr. P.S.Ahuja Announces Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award 2014 |url=http://pib.nic.in/newsite/erelease.aspx?relid=110063 |publisher=Dr. P.S.Ahuja Announces Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award 2014 |date=26 September 2014|access-date=28 September 2014}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web| title=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science & Technology 2014 | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/WriteReadData/LatestUpdates/201409260153504671808ssb_awardees2014.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141006130418/http://ssbprize.gov.in/WriteReadData/LatestUpdates/201409260153504671808ssb_awardees2014.pdf | archive-date=2014-10-06}}</ref>
